changelog_text:
First stable release of **GEE - General Earth Enhancements**, a StarMap mod for Kitten Space Agency that puts the real world on Earth.

> Programmed entirely by Claude (Anthropic's AI). It is a hobby project, so expect rough edges, and please report what you find.

## Changes since 0.1.0-beta

- **Quiet log by default:** GEE no longer writes progress and timing lines to the game's log. Errors are still logged.
- **Debug option:** "Debug" in the GEE menu, or the checkbox at the bottom of the window, turns the log lines back on and shows statistics (tiles, buildings, lights, performance) in the window. It is saved as `DebugLogging` in `settings.json`.
- The window is shorter: the statistics only show with Debug on. Errors (satellite imagery, night glow, missing models, download errors) always show.

## What's in it

- **Buildings and roads** from OpenStreetMap, streamed around the camera, with facades, roofs, details and windows
- **Far field**: simplified buildings out to tens of kilometres
- **Night**: lit windows, street lights in towns, city lights visible from orbit
- **Satellite imagery** (Sentinel-2 cloudless) when seen from altitude
- **Launch complexes** at all of the game's Earth pads: LC-39A/B with the VAB, Starbase, ELA-4, SLC-4E and LC-1
- Every part can be switched off on its own in the mod window or `settings.json`

## Install

1. Install Kitten Space Agency and the StarMap mod loader (0.4.8 or newer).
2. Download `GEE-0.1.0.zip` below and extract it into `Documents/My Games/Kitten Space Agency/mods/`,
   so that you get `mods/GEE/mod.toml`. Or install GEE with Borea.
3. Start the game through StarMap.

An internet connection is needed the first time an area is shown; downloads are cached in `mods/GEE/cache/`.

## Feedback

Ideas, bugs, places that look wrong: please open an [issue](https://github.com/KarloDerEchte/KSA-GEE-General-Earth-Enhancements/issues) or post in the [forum thread](https://forums.ahwoo.com/threads/gee-general-earth-enhancements.1527/). Pull requests are welcome.

listing.description:
GEE streams buildings and roads from OpenStreetMap around the camera, lights up cities at night and drapes satellite imagery over the ground when you look down from altitude.

- **Buildings and roads** with facades, roofs, details nearby and lit windows. Roads are laid on the terrain, and the game's trees are cleared from roads and buildings.
- **Far field**: simplified buildings out to tens of kilometres, so cities stay visible after launch.
- **Night**: lit windows, street lights in towns, and city lights visible from orbit.
- **Satellite imagery** (Sentinel-2 cloudless, 2016) from altitude.
- **Launch complexes** at all of the game's Earth pads: LC-39A/B with the VAB and a crew access arm, Starbase, ELA-4, SLC-4E and LC-1.

Every part can be switched off on its own. The mod needs an internet connection the first time an area is shown and caches everything it downloads.

This mod was programmed entirely by Claude (Anthropic's AI). It is a hobby project, so expect rough edges.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), © OpenMapTiles, tiles by OpenFreeMap. Imagery: EOxCloudless by EOX IT Services GmbH (contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2016), CC BY 4.0.
